deadline.value: Fall admissions have a priority deadline of December 1.
deadline.quote: Fall admissions have a priority deadline of December 1. International applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until March 31 and domestic applications will be reviewed until May 15.

gre_general.value: GRE neither required nor considered when making admissions decisions.
gre_general.quote: ■GRE: neither required nor considered when making admissions decisions

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in this field.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study and help departments evaluate applicants' readiness for graduate school.

supervisor.value: Applicants strongly encouraged to contact faculty directly for more information about laboratories.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact faculty directly for more information about individual laboratories. Faculty research areas may be viewed on the research webpage.

funding.value: All graduate students receive competitive fellowships or 12 months of GTA or GRA support.
funding.quote: All others receive 12 months of GTA or GRA support

entry_route.value: Regular admission requires an earned bachelor's degree with a minimum 3.0 GPA.
entry_route.quote: Regular admission to a graduate degree is open to applicants whose grade point average (GPA) meets or exceeds the 3.00 required by the Graduate School for the last half of the credits earned for the undergraduate (bachelor’s) degree, and whose academic background meets the requirements of the admitting academic unit.
